t: Hardened steel straight shank with high-quality tungsten carbide tip. Superior carbide grade ensures faster bit penetration with outstanding durability and consistent drilling life. Optimised flute design for efficient debris removal. Sharpened cutting tips allow fast drilling, even in hard materials, prolonging battery life of a cordless drill. Supplied in a sturdy case.
b: Contents: 8 Multi-Drill Bits, 26 Screwdriver Bits & Magnet Holder.
Suitable For Use with 3-Jaw Chuck Machines on Rotary & Impact Modes
Suitable for Wide Range of Building Materials, Ceramics & Tiles, Wood, Plastic, Thin Sheet Metals & Aluminium
Compatible with Most Power Tool Brands
